signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Lead onboarding and implementation across customer departments, ensuring timelines, scope, and expectations are aligned.
Lead discovery calls to map use cases, edge cases, and integration needs.
Create product scoping documents and delivery blueprints for agentic AI workflows.
Engage executive stakeholders, deliver clear, compelling insights on how Agentic AI drives measurable ROI and transforms operations at scale.
Collaborate across the team with sales, customer success, and product to ensure customer success.
